title: Search combobox with suggestions
when: The user wants a text field that suggests matching options as you type, such as cities, products or tags.
inputs: the option list or data file
prompt:
Goal: A WAI-ARIA combobox with a listbox popup, arrow key selection, accent insensitive matching and an announced result count.
Steps:
1. <label for="q">; <input id="q" role="combobox" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="q-list" autocomplete="off">; <ul id="q-list" role="listbox"> of <li role="option" id>.
2. Filter on input with a 150 ms debounce, case and accent insensitive (normalize("NFD") and strip combining marks), at most 8 results.
3. ArrowDown and ArrowUp set aria-activedescendant and aria-selected while focus stays in the input; Enter chooses, Escape closes, then clears.
4. Highlight the match with a <mark> built by createElement, never innerHTML.
5. Choose on pointerdown with preventDefault so the input does not blur first.
6. A role="status" region says 5 suggestions or No matches.
Quality bar:
- The popup width matches the input.
- Prefix matches rank above inner matches.
- The listbox closes on blur.
Pitfalls:
- Moving real focus into the list, which breaks typing.
- Fetching on every keystroke without a debounce.
- Losing the typed text on Escape.
Verify:
- [ ] Combobox roles and aria-controls are set.
- [ ] aria-expanded follows the popup.
- [ ] Arrow keys update aria-activedescendant.
- [ ] The count is announced.
Output: Field markup, combobox.css and combobox.js reading the options array or a local JSON file.

examples.input: campo de cidade com sugestoes enquanto digita
examples.output: role combobox input, listbox of up to 8 cities, accent insensitive filter, aria-activedescendant, count in status
